textRun.content: New York University, Stern School of Business,
Bachelor of Science in Business; Intended Concentrations: Finance and Econometrics & Quantitative Economics
Westlake High School	Austin, TX | May 2026
Finance Professor at University of Alabama,
Analyzed earnings-call language and subsequent equity performance using web scraping, topic modeling, and machine-learning methods.
Built statistical models connecting management guidance with post-earnings stock-price behavior; contributed to two research papers and am co-authoring a third.
Modeled municipal debt capacity using historical financial data and projected cash flows; evaluated bond-financing options for infrastructure expansion.
Presented analysis and recommendations to department executives and the Deputy Treasurer of the City of Austin.
Developed and backtested a multi-equity trading strategy incorporating signal generation, position sizing, and risk controls.

Direct operations for a global financial-literacy nonprofit with 34 chapters across 9 countries and 10,000+ students reached; secured four NGO partnerships and oversee chapter onboarding and administration.
Managed operations, onboarding, and public-consultation research; co-authored policy publications, including a recommendation later reflected in a Financial Stability Board final framework.
Placed among Texas's top 10 Operations Research teams and qualified for ICDC; built a time-series sales forecast adopted by a local restaurant.
Led a 28-student course and co-led a 150-member organization; organized WESTMUN for 300 delegates.
Created an FLL Robotics Program for the WMK branch to expand STEM access for low-income communities.
Fundraised $500, organized the curriculum, and led a week-long course with 70 signups and five volunteers.
Created video lectures and a remote debugging website for future programs.
Python, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, financial modeling, statistical modeling, research planning
Fundamentals of Finance - University of Pennsylvania; Python and Statistics for Financial Analysis - The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2x John Locke Global Essay Competition High Commendation (top 3%) in Economics & Theology
Wharton High School Data Science Competition Semifinalist (top 25 teams globally)
DECA ICDC Qualifier in Operations Research Event (top 10 teams in Texas)
3x National Spanish Exam Gold Medalist (98th percentile)
